memory_candidates.content: In the ModelChecker/BimodalLogic pairing, a bounded-search-parameter space built by folding positions modulo an exact segment length (e.g. WitnessRegistry.wrap() folding back/fwd by exact period) is non-monotone in that length: representability is a divisibility question, not a magnitude one, so 'segment length >= f(closure size)' is not a sufficient completeness condition on its own -- a family with period p is representable at length n iff p | n, so raising n can make a previously-representable family unrepresentable. When reasoning about bounded-search completeness claims in this project, check for exact-modulus folding before accepting a magnitude-only bound as sufficient.
